description: This Java class, FixedDepositProductSheetPopulator, is responsible for populating an Excel workbook sheet with data about fixed deposit products. It reads a list of FixedDepositProductData objects and writes the relevant details into an Excel sheet, applying formatting and layout. The class extends AbstractWorkbookPopulator and provides methods for setting up the sheet layout, writing data, and managing the population process.

classes.name: FixedDepositProductSheetPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates an Excel sheet with data related to fixed deposit products, converting a list of FixedDepositProductData objects into a formatted Excel sheet.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Fills the Excel sheet with data from the list of FixedDepositProductData objects, creating rows and setting cell values accordingly.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets up the header row and column widths for the Excel sheet.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of FixedDepositProductData objects to be populated.

methods.name: getProductsSize
methods.description: Returns the number of FixedDepositProductData objects in the list.
